content.value_statement: Generative art requests often need both a creative concept and reproducible code. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to create seeded p5.js art with interactive controls.
actual_capabilities: Creates an algorithmic philosophy before implementation.
Guides p5.js generative art with seeded randomness.
Uses a provided HTML viewer template for interactive controls.
Supports seed navigation, parameter sliders, reset, and PNG download actions.
Encourages original art instead of copying existing artists.
limitations: Generated viewers may depend on public CDNs for p5.js and fonts.
It does not guarantee visual quality without review and iteration.
It is focused on p5.js browser artifacts, not native graphics tools.
It does not provide legal clearance for commercial artwork.

use_cases.title: Prototype Creative Code
use_cases.description: Turn a visual idea into a reproducible p5.js sketch with controls for seeds and parameters.

use_cases.title: Explore Abstract Directions
use_cases.description: Generate many branded abstract compositions before selecting a direction for a campaign, installation, or background.

use_cases.title: Teach Generative Systems
use_cases.description: Explain seeded randomness, flow fields, and particle systems through a complete generative art workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Seeded Sketch
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one interactive artwork.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use algorithmic-art to create a p5.js generative artwork about ocean currents. Include a short philosophy and an interactive HTML artifact.

prompt_templates.title: Explore Visual Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate three distinct visual directions for a seeded flow-field artwork about urban rhythm. Recommend parameters users can adjust.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with a curatorial concept.
prompt_templates.prompt: Transform this exhibition theme into an algorithmic philosophy, then express it as interactive generative art with reproducible seed controls: [theme].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Gallery Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a cohesive series.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cohesive set of four p5.js generative pieces. Define shared design rules, unique algorithms, and seed ranges for each piece.

output_examples.input: User asks for a generative artwork inspired by tidal maps.
output_examples.output: A movement statement, an interactive browser artifact, seed controls, sliders for turbulence and density, and download support.

output_examples.input: User requests 100 seeded variations for a poster background.
output_examples.output: A repeatable viewer workflow with seed navigation, variation guidance, and parameters for comparing poster-ready compositions.

output_examples.input: User wants a lesson on flow fields and particle systems.
output_examples.output: A concept-first explanation, an interactive p5.js sketch, and controls that show how forces change the visual result.

best_practices: Start with a clear subject, mood, and constraints so the philosophy has useful direction.
Ask for seed ranges or parameter names when repeatable exploration matters.
Review generated HTML before publishing, especially any external CDN or font links.
anti_patterns: Do not ask it to copy a living artist exact style or signature composition.
Do not treat random decoration as finished generative art without a coherent algorithm.
Do not rely on unreviewed external links in exported artifacts for sensitive environments.

faq.question: Does this create images directly?
faq.answer: It guides an AI agent to create p5.js artwork and an HTML viewer, not static image files by itself.

faq.question: Can outputs be reproduced?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires seeded randomness, so the same seed should produce the same visual result.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Generated viewers may load p5.js and fonts from public CDNs unless those links are replaced.

faq.question: Can I change parameters?
faq.answer: Yes. The template asks for sliders, seed controls, color controls when useful, reset, and download actions.

faq.question: Is it safe to publish generated artwork?
faq.answer: Review the HTML, external dependencies, and any rights concerns before publishing or commercial use.

faq.question: Does it support Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
